paper.title: MEM: Multi-Scale Embodied Memory for Vision Language Action Models

reader_profile.goal: Mechanisms, training and transfer to UMI/robot pretraining

execution.scope: Full methods, experiment and appendix reading; nine numbered figures plus appendix equations visually reviewed; no model training/inference; no official MEM training code obtained.

claims.claim: 两种时间尺度通过高层摘要/子任务与低层视频动作分工
claims.limitations: 高层观测窗口在III-A与III-B的记号不同，完整共享/独立权重配置未披露

claims.claim: 每四层加入时间计算，复用ViT参数并输出当前时刻表示
claims.limitations: 附录3索引与分离注意力描述不完全一致，无法恢复精确算子

claims.claim: 四路相机单H100测试下16帧推理约0.2秒，对照约3.5秒
claims.limitations: 读图约值，非训练吞吐或包括高层通信在内的完整系统时延

claims.claim: LLM用子任务语言及成功失败指示生成摘要更新监督
claims.limitations: 没有完整提示、标注LLM、长度和质检协议

claims.claim: FAST和flow专家并行训练，专家梯度不流入VLM骨干
claims.limitations: 教学损失不是作者配方；参数组和任务loss权重未披露

claims.claim: 预训练六观测一秒间隔，后训练报告最多18帧54秒
claims.limitations: 不能由此指定所有任务的stride或padding

claims.claim: 两种记忆组合优于各自及朴素指令历史
claims.limitations: 指标为任务进度；没有独立控制摘要长度、语义内容等全部因素

claims.claim: 失败历史帮助策略利用同样的纠正数据
claims.limitations: 两个特定任务；非推理时梯度更新或任意错误自动恢复

claims.claim: 预训练时学习历史优于目标任务后训练才加入历史
claims.limitations: 未分解视频来源、算力预算、混合任务各自贡献

claims.claim: 一般操作任务平均能力大致保持
claims.limitations: 逐任务有升有降，不证明消除因果混淆

claims.claim: 数据多样性是避免因果混淆的原因
claims.limitations: 作者归因，没有独立数据多样性消融

discrepancies.detail: High-level conditioned on current observation vs short observation history.
Inner attention shows both space/time index sets, while prose emphasizes separable space-time operations; special k(0,0) term insufficiently explained.

teaching_materials: F notation to avoid K off-by-one ambiguity
token loss and flow matching equations including stop-gradient are teaching formulations, not released MEM code
UMI/robot transfer suggestions are proposed, not executed

code_evidence.status: No matching official MEM implementation/config obtained in checked source scope; third-party reproduction excluded
